When you talk to AI it can feel like there's a real person talking back to you, but it's actually a computer program known as A Large Language Model. In this video, we break down how these models work at a very high level.
Huge thanks to Colin Kealty, Senior Machine Learning Engineer at Red Hat for helping with this video - https://huggingface.co/bartowski
